scripts.serve: bun run --cwd ../web build && bun run src/main.ts serve
scripts.compile: bun run web:build && mkdir -p ../../dist && bun build --compile --asset=templates --asset=../web/dist --outfile=../../dist/bento src/main.ts
scripts.compile:amd64: bun run web:build && mkdir -p ../../dist && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --asset=templates --asset=../web/dist --outfile=../../dist/bento-linux-amd64 src/main.ts
scripts.compile:arm64: bun run web:build && mkdir -p ../../dist && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --asset=templates --asset=../web/dist --outfile=../../dist/bento-linux-arm64 src/main.ts
